rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for deliberately watching or examining something carefully.

example.english: I carefully observe the little bird.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 sam1 gun1 caat3 zek3 zoek3 zai2

rows.note: Use this in everyday speech for obeying rules, customs, laws, or religious requirements.

example.english: We observe the fasting rule when worshipping.
example.jyutping: baai3 san4 go2 zan6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 sau2 zaai1

rows.note: Use this when the comment takes the form of pointing out a fact, problem, or consequence.

example.english: They observe that the plan has a flaw.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zi2 ceot1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 lau6 dung6

rows.note: Use this before the name of a festival or holiday when saying that people celebrate or observe it.

example.english: We observe the Mid-Autumn Festival every year.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 nin4 nin4 gwo3 zung1 cau1
